headline: President Bush signed an order in 2002 updating the Manual for Courts-Martial, the rulebook for military trials.
what_it_does: This order makes changes to the Manual for Courts-Martial, which sets the procedures and rules of evidence used in U.S. military justice cases. No summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the U.S. armed forces
who_it_affects.how: Changes to the manual can affect how service members accused of crimes under military law are charged, tried, or sentenced.
They must follow the updated rules when handling courts-martial.
